# Fig 3A — ARC: integrated chromatin and transcriptional landscapes

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
Paired snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq profiles from the arcuate nucleus (ARC) were co-embedded and clustered. Cluster identity was confirmed by matching ATAC-derived gene activity scores to established marker gene expression patterns from the RNA modality.
:::

## Co-embedding and cluster overview

```{r}
ARC <- readRDS("../Data.Objects/final_ARC_merged_clusters_20250206.rds")

```

```{R, fig3A.ARC.UMAP, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, eval=T}

ARC$cluster <- factor(ARC$cluster, levels=as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(levels(ARC$cluster))))))

DimPlot(ARC, split.by = "tech", group.by = "cluster")

Idents(ARC) <- "cluster"
```

```{r}
#DimPlot(ARC, group.by = c("group"))

```

```{r, fig3A.ARC.cell.counts}
arc_meta <- ARC@meta.data

rna_tab <- table(Cluster   = arc_meta$cluster[arc_meta$tech == "RNA"],
                 Condition = arc_meta$condition[arc_meta$tech == "RNA"])
knitr::kable(rna_tab, caption = "ARC RNA — cells per cluster × condition")

atac_tab <- table(Cluster   = arc_meta$cluster[arc_meta$tech == "ATAC"],
                  Condition = arc_meta$group[arc_meta$tech == "ATAC"])
knitr::kable(atac_tab, caption = "ARC ATAC — cells per cluster × condition")
```

## Marker gene expression across modalities

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
Dotplots and heatmaps show expression of canonical ARC neuronal marker genes across all clusters, for both the RNA (normalised counts) and ATAC (gene activity scores inferred from chromatin accessibility) modalities.
:::

```{r}

mark_ge <- c("Npy","Ccbe1","Dach2","Tmem26","Pomc",
             "Sntb1","Vgll3","Tcf7l2","Sv2b","Hydin","Mcc",
             "Col24a1","Pdgfd","Colec12","Lmo7","Megf11","Nfib","Qrfpr","Alk",
             "Pdzrn3","Gem","Sim1","Bnc2","Sema3e","Unc13c","Lef1","Lhx9","Rgs6")

# ── Helper: compute per-cluster mean expression and percent expressed ─────────
calc_dotplot_dat <- function(seu, genes, assay = "RNA", slot = "data") {
  count <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay, slot = slot))
  meta  <- seu@meta.data
  clusts <- unique(meta$cluster)

  dat_list <- lapply(genes, function(ge) {
    exp <- count[ge, ]
    cluster_list <- lapply(clusts, function(cl) {
      cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$cluster == cl]
      ex    <- exp[cells]
      setNames(c(mean(ex), mean(ex > 0) * 100), c("exp", "prop"))
    })
    names(cluster_list) <- clusts
    mat <- do.call(rbind, cluster_list)
    cbind(data.frame(gene = ge, cluster = rownames(mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE), mat)
  })

  dat <- do.call(rbind, dat_list)
  dat$cluster <- factor(dat$cluster,
                        levels = as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(dat$cluster)))))
  dat$gene <- factor(dat$gene, levels = genes)
  dat
}

# ── Helper: compute per-cluster mean expression matrix for heatmap ────────────
calc_heatmap_mat <- function(seu, genes, assay = "RNA", slot = "data") {
  count <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay, slot = slot))
  meta  <- seu@meta.data
  mat <- sapply(levels(meta$cluster), function(cl) {
    cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$cluster == cl]
    rowMeans(count[genes, cells, drop = FALSE])
  })
  mat[!matrixStats::rowSds(mat) == 0, ]
}

colors_hm   <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(800)
breaksList  <- seq(-4, 4, by = 0.01)

```

::: {.panel-tabset}

# Fig 3C — Coordinated transcriptional and chromatin changes in ARC AgRP/LepR neurons (Cluster 0)

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
Genes consistently upregulated in the ob/ob condition were identified in ARC cluster 0 (AgRP/LepR neurons). For each gene, the Pearson correlation between RNA expression and ATAC gene activity across conditions was computed. This separates genes with **coordinated chromatin remodeling** (high RNA–ATAC correlation) from those that change transcriptionally **without corresponding accessibility changes** (low RNA–ATAC correlation). Z-score heatmaps show per-condition averages; the ATAC row order is locked to the RNA hierarchical clustering to enable direct visual comparison.
:::

::: {.panel-tabset}

### High OB expression, concordant ATAC (top 500 by RNA–ATAC correlation)

```{r, fig3C.ARC.most.corr.prep}

# ── helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
clean_conditions_rna <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("leptinARC3h",  "lep3h",  x)
  x <- gsub("leptinARC24h", "lep27h", x)
  x <- gsub("leptinARC72h", "lep75h", x)
  x <- gsub("Leptin3hr",    "lep3h",  x)
  x <- gsub("Leptin24hr",   "lep27h", x)
  x <- gsub("Leptin72hr",   "lep75h", x)
  x <- gsub("^ob$",         "OB",     x)
  x <- gsub("^wt$",         "WT",     x)
  factor(x, levels = c("OB","lep3h","lep27h","lep75h","WT"))
}

clean_conditions_atac <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("Leptin3hr",  "lep3h",  x)
  x <- gsub("Leptin24hr", "lep27h", x)
  x <- gsub("Leptin72hr", "lep75h", x)
  x <- gsub("^ob$",       "OB",     x)
  x <- gsub("^wt$",       "WT",     x)
  factor(x, levels = c("OB","lep3h","lep27h","lep75h","WT"))
}

avg_by_condition <- function(mat, meta_col) {
  lvls <- levels(meta_col)
  out  <- sapply(lvls, function(cond) {
    idx <- which(meta_col == cond)
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(mat)))
    rowMeans(mat[, idx, drop = FALSE])
  })
  out
}

# ── 1. RNA + ATAC: subset cluster 0 and compute per-condition averages ────────
seu_rna_c0  <- subset(ARC, tech == "RNA"  & cluster == "0")
seu_atac_c0 <- subset(ARC, tech == "ATAC" & cluster == "0")

mat_rna  <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(seu_rna_c0,  slot = "data"))
mat_atac <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(seu_atac_c0, slot = "data"))

cond_rna  <- clean_conditions_rna(seu_rna_c0$condition)
cond_atac <- clean_conditions_atac(seu_atac_c0$group)

avg_rna  <- avg_by_condition(mat_rna,  cond_rna)
avg_atac <- avg_by_condition(mat_atac, cond_atac)

# ── 2. Identify genes consistently upregulated in OB ────────────────────────
#    OB average must be strictly higher than every other condition's average
#    (NA in another condition counts as OB being higher)
other_conds <- setdiff(colnames(avg_rna), "OB")
ob_gt_all   <- apply(avg_rna[, other_conds, drop = FALSE], 2,
                     function(x) is.na(x) | avg_rna[, "OB"] > x)
genes_ob_dn <- rownames(avg_rna)[rowSums(ob_gt_all, na.rm = TRUE) == length(other_conds)]

# ── 3. Compute RNA–ATAC correlation for all OB-high genes; keep top 500 ───────
shared_genes <- intersect(genes_ob_dn, rownames(avg_atac))
gene_cors <- sapply(shared_genes, function(g) {
  rna_vec  <- avg_rna[g, ]
  atac_vec <- avg_atac[g, ]
  keep     <- !is.na(rna_vec) & !is.na(atac_vec)
  if (sum(keep) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  if (sd(rna_vec[keep]) == 0 || sd(atac_vec[keep]) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  cor(rna_vec[keep], atac_vec[keep])
})
gene_cors <- sort(gene_cors, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
if (length(genes_ob_dn) > 500) {
  genes_ob_dn <- names(gene_cors)[1:min(500, length(gene_cors))]
}

cat("Genes consistently upregulated in OB (cluster 0 RNA):", length(genes_ob_dn), "\n")

# ── 4. Drop empty conditions and find genes complete in BOTH RNA and ATAC ────
# Remove conditions (columns) with no cells in either modality
rna_keep_conds  <- colSums(!is.na(avg_rna))  > 0
atac_keep_conds <- colSums(!is.na(avg_atac)) > 0

avg_rna_filt  <- avg_rna[,  rna_keep_conds,  drop = FALSE]
avg_atac_filt <- avg_atac[, atac_keep_conds, drop = FALSE]

cat("RNA conditions with cells: ",  paste(colnames(avg_rna_filt),  collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("ATAC conditions with cells: ", paste(colnames(avg_atac_filt), collapse=", "), "\n")

# Keep only genes present in both matrices with no NA and non-zero variance
genes_rna_ok  <- genes_ob_dn[
  genes_ob_dn %in% rownames(avg_rna_filt) &
  apply(avg_rna_filt[genes_ob_dn[genes_ob_dn %in% rownames(avg_rna_filt)], , drop=FALSE],
        1, function(x) all(!is.na(x)) && sd(x) > 0)
]
genes_final <- intersect(
  genes_rna_ok,
  rownames(avg_atac_filt)[
    apply(avg_atac_filt[rownames(avg_atac_filt) %in% genes_rna_ok, , drop=FALSE],
          1, function(x) all(!is.na(x)) && sd(x) > 0)
  ]
)

cat("Genes passing NA/variance filter in both modalities:", length(genes_final), "\n")

# ── 5. Z-score matrices using the shared complete gene set ────────────────────
zscore_rna  <- t(scale(t(avg_rna_filt[genes_final,  , drop = FALSE])))
zscore_atac <- t(scale(t(avg_atac_filt[genes_final, , drop = FALSE])))

# ── 6. RNA heatmap with hierarchical row clustering ───────────────────────────
colors    <- colorRampPalette(c("blue","white","red"))(400)
breaks_hm <- seq(-2, 2, by = 0.01)

# Extract hierarchical clustering row order — shared across both heatmaps
p_rna_clust <- pheatmap(zscore_rna, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                         silent = TRUE)
genes_ordered   <- rownames(zscore_rna)[p_rna_clust$tree_row$order]
zscore_atac_ord <- zscore_atac[genes_ordered, , drop = FALSE]

# Preserve gene order for downstream use
arc_clust0_ob_dn_gene_order <- genes_final

dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(gene = genes_ordered, row = seq_along(genes_ordered)),
          "tables/ARC_clust0_OB_high_most_corr_genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{R, fig3C.ARC.most.corr.RNA, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}

pheatmap(zscore_rna[genes_ordered, , drop = FALSE],
         main           = "ARC Cluster 0 | RNA\nZ-score avg expression per condition\n(OB consistently upregulated genes)",
         cluster_rows   = FALSE,
         cluster_cols   = FALSE,
         show_rownames  = FALSE,
         show_colnames  = TRUE,
         breaks         = breaks_hm,
         color          = colors,
         treeheight_row = 0)

```

```{R, fig3C.ARC.most.corr.ATAC, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}

pheatmap(zscore_atac_ord,
         main           = "ARC Cluster 0 | ATAC gene activity\nZ-score avg per condition\n(row order from RNA clustering)",
         cluster_rows   = FALSE,
         cluster_cols   = FALSE,
         show_rownames  = FALSE,
         show_colnames  = TRUE,
         breaks         = breaks_hm,
         color          = colors,
         treeheight_row = 0)

```

### Least concordant RNA–ATAC genes (bottom 500 by correlation, all cluster 0 genes)

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
All cluster 0 genes present in both RNA and ATAC modalities are ranked by RNA–ATAC correlation across conditions. The bottom 500 (least correlated) are shown here with no OB-high prerequisite. These genes show the greatest discordance between transcriptional and chromatin accessibility dynamics, suggesting their expression may be regulated independently of large-scale chromatin remodeling.
:::

```{r, fig3C.ARC.least.corr.prep}

# ── All genes in cluster 0: keep the 500 LEAST correlated RNA-ATAC ───────────
# No OB constraint — compute correlations across all genes present in both
# avg_rna_filt and avg_atac_filt already computed above

all_shared <- intersect(rownames(avg_rna_filt), rownames(avg_atac_filt))

gene_cors_lc <- sapply(all_shared, function(g) {
  rna_vec  <- avg_rna_filt[g, ]
  atac_vec <- avg_atac_filt[g, ]
  keep     <- !is.na(rna_vec) & !is.na(atac_vec)
  if (sum(keep) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  if (sd(rna_vec[keep]) == 0 || sd(atac_vec[keep]) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  cor(rna_vec[keep], atac_vec[keep])
})

gene_cors_lc <- sort(gene_cors_lc, decreasing = FALSE, na.last = NA)
genes_lc     <- names(gene_cors_lc)[1:min(500, length(gene_cors_lc))]

# NA/variance filter in both modalities
genes_lc_rna_ok <- genes_lc[
  apply(avg_rna_filt[genes_lc, , drop = FALSE],
        1, function(x) all(!is.na(x)) && sd(x) > 0)
]
genes_lc_final <- genes_lc_rna_ok[
  apply(avg_atac_filt[genes_lc_rna_ok, , drop = FALSE],
        1, function(x) all(!is.na(x)) && sd(x) > 0)
]

cat("Least-correlated genes passing filter:", length(genes_lc_final), "\n")

zscore_rna_lc  <- t(scale(t(avg_rna_filt[genes_lc_final,  , drop = FALSE])))
zscore_atac_lc <- t(scale(t(avg_atac_filt[genes_lc_final, , drop = FALSE])))

colors    <- colorRampPalette(c("blue","white","red"))(400)
breaks_hm <- seq(-2, 2, by = 0.01)

p_rna_lc_clust <- pheatmap(zscore_rna_lc, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                            silent = TRUE)
genes_ordered_lc   <- rownames(zscore_rna_lc)[p_rna_lc_clust$tree_row$order]
zscore_atac_lc_ord <- zscore_atac_lc[genes_ordered_lc, , drop = FALSE]

arc_clust0_ob_least_corr_gene_order <- genes_ordered_lc

write.csv(data.frame(gene = genes_ordered_lc, row = seq_along(genes_ordered_lc)),
          "tables/ARC_clust0_least_corr_genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{R, fig3C.ARC.least.corr.RNA, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}

pheatmap(zscore_rna_lc[genes_ordered_lc, , drop = FALSE],
         main           = "ARC Cluster 0 | RNA\nZ-score avg expression per condition\n(least RNA-ATAC correlated genes, all cluster 0)",
         cluster_rows   = FALSE,
         cluster_cols   = FALSE,
         show_rownames  = FALSE,
         show_colnames  = TRUE,
         breaks         = breaks_hm,
         color          = colors,
```

# Fig 3F — STAT3 chromatin occupancy at motif sites in LepR neuron subtypes (Clusters 0, 3, 17)

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
STAT3 (MA0144.1) footprint analysis in snATAC-seq data from ARC LepR neuron subtypes: cluster 0 (AgRP/LepR), cluster 3 (POMC/LepR), and cluster 17 (BNC2/LepR). Tn5 insertion enrichment around STAT3 binding motifs is shown per condition, smoothed over a ±7 bp window and restricted to positions within 100 bp of the motif centre.
:::

## Data loading and motif annotation

```{r, eval=T}

seu_atac <- readRDS("../Data.Objects/seuATAC_allSample_ARC.rds")
DefaultAssay(seu_atac) <- "ATAC"
seu_atac[["tech"]] <- "ATAC"

seu_atac@assays$ATAC@fragments[[1]]@path <- '../Data.Objects/frags/fragments.tsv.gz'

names_1 <- names(ARC$cluster)
names_2 <- names(seu_atac$orig.ident)
seu_atac$keep <- names_2 %in% names_1

seu_atac_sub <- subset(seu_atac, keep)
seu_atac_sub$cluster <- ARC$cluster[match(names(seu_atac_sub$orig.ident), names(ARC$cluster))]

```

```{r}

motif_ids <- c("MA0523.1", "MA0498.1", "MA0144.1")

opts <- list(ID = motif_ids)

pwm <- getMatrixSet(x = JASPAR2022, opts = opts)

pwm_plus <- pwm[3]  # MA0144.1 = STAT3

ARC_motif <- AddMotifs(seu_atac_sub, genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10, pfm = pwm_plus)

# ── Subset and run Footprint separately for each cluster ─────────────────────
ARC_motif_c0 <- subset(ARC_motif, cluster == "0")
ARC_motif_c0 <- Footprint(object = ARC_motif_c0, motif.name = "MA0144.1",
                           genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)

ARC_motif_c3 <- subset(ARC_motif, cluster == "3")
ARC_motif_c3 <- Footprint(object = ARC_motif_c3, motif.name = "MA0144.1",
                           genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)

ARC_motif_c17 <- subset(ARC_motif, cluster == "17")
ARC_motif_c17 <- Footprint(object = ARC_motif_c17, motif.name = "MA0144.1",
                            genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)

# Backward-compatible alias so the plot chunk below still works
ARC_motif_sub <- ARC_motif_c0

```

```{r, fig3F.footprint.function, eval=T}

custom_footprint_plot3 <- function(object, features, group.by = NULL,
                                   normalization = "subtract") {

  assay     <- Seurat::DefaultAssay(object = object)
  plot.data <- GetFootprintData(object = object, features = features,
                                assay = assay, group.by = group.by)
  plot.data %<>% dplyr::filter(abs(position) <= 200)

  motif.sizes <- Signac:::GetMotifSize(object = object, features = features, assay = assay)
  obs    <- plot.data[plot.data$class == "Observed", ]
  expect <- plot.data[plot.data$class == "Expected", ]
  base   <- ceiling(motif.sizes / 2)

  obs$flanks <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(obs)), function(x) {
    pos  <- abs(obs[x, "position"])
    size <- base[[obs[x, "feature"]]]
    (pos > size) & (pos < (size + 50))
  })

  if (!is.null(normalization)) {
    correction.vec <- setNames(expect$norm.value, paste(expect$position, expect$feature))
    obs$norm.value <- obs$norm.value - correction.vec[paste(obs$position, obs$feature)]
  }

  i <- 1
  df <- obs[obs$feature == features[[i]], ]

  final_mat <- lapply(unique(df$group), function(grp) {
    df_temp <- df %>%
      filter(group == grp) %>%
      group_by(position) %>%
      summarise(mean_norm = mean(norm.value), .groups = "drop")
    df_temp$mean_norm_slide <- slide_dbl(df_temp$mean_norm, mean, .before = 7, .after = 7)
    df_temp$group <- grp
    dplyr::filter(df_temp, abs(position) < 101)
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, final_mat)

  axis.min <- range(df$mean_norm_slide)[1] - diff(range(df$mean_norm_slide)) / 10
  axis.max <- range(df$mean_norm_slide)[2] + diff(range(df$mean_norm_slide)) / 10

  ggplot(df, aes(x = position, y = mean_norm_slide, color = group)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = arc_cond_colors_raw) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
    xlab("Distance from motif (bp)") +
    ylab("Tn5 insertion enrichment") +
    theme_classic() +
    ylim(c(axis.min, axis.max)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1)))
}

```

# Fig 3G — STAT3 target gene expression across ARC neuronal subtypes (WT)

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
STAT3 target genes were identified by intersecting SCENIC+ eRegulon regions (Stat3 TF) with region-to-gene importance scores from the multiome CRE-gene linkage analysis. Expression of these targets (scaled RNA) is shown in WT mice across ARC clusters 0 (AgRP/LepR), 3 (POMC/LepR), and 17 (BNC2/LepR), averaged per cluster. Hierarchical clustering of genes reveals **distinct expression programs across neuronal subtypes despite shared STAT3 activation**.
:::

```{r}

library(stringr)

grp_colors <- arc_cond_colors

seu <- subset(ARC, tech=="RNA")

# ── Capture HVG background BEFORE subsetting to STAT3 targets ────────────────
# VariableFeatures may be empty on a subsetted object; fall back to the parent,
# and if that is also empty recompute from scratch on the RNA subset.
hvg_background <- VariableFeatures(seu)
if (length(hvg_background) == 0) {
  hvg_background <- VariableFeatures(ARC)
  cat("VariableFeatures empty on RNA subset — trying parent ARC object\n")
}
if (length(hvg_background) == 0) {
  cat("No variable features stored — running FindVariableFeatures (nfeatures = 3000)\n")
  seu_tmp        <- FindVariableFeatures(seu, nfeatures = 3000, verbose = FALSE)
  hvg_background <- VariableFeatures(seu_tmp)
  rm(seu_tmp)
}
# Restrict to genes actually present in the RNA assay
hvg_background <- intersect(hvg_background, rownames(seu))
cat("HVG background genes:", length(hvg_background), "\n")

ereg <- rtracklayer::import("../Data.Objects/scenic_plus_res2/arc/eRegulons.bed")
r2g <- read.table("../Data.Objects/scenic_plus_res2/arc/r2g.importance.bed", sep ="\t")

tf <- str_split(ereg$name, "_", simplify = T) %>% .[,1]
stat3 <- as.data.frame(ereg[tf %in% "Stat3"])

r2g$V3 <- r2g$V3-499
r2g$V2 <- r2g$V2-500

# ── All regulon target genes as background (all TFs, not just STAT3) ──────────
all_regulon_background <- unique(r2g$V17)
cat("All-regulon background genes:", length(all_regulon_background), "\n")

motif_hits <- merge(stat3, r2g, by.x=c("seqnames","start"), by.y=c("V1","V3") )
seu <- seu[which(rownames(seu) %in% motif_hits$V17)]

```

```{r}

# Cells × gene scaled matrix (scale.data must be pre-computed in the object)
scaled_all <- GetAssayData(object = seu, slot = "scale.data")
if (nrow(scaled_all) == 0) stop("scale.data slot is empty — run ScaleData() before proceeding")

data <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(scaled_all)))

# Reshape to genes × cells
data3 <- as.data.frame(t(data))

my_meta <- data.frame(
  cluster = seu$cluster,
  group   = seu$condition,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

my_meta$group <- gsub("leptinARC3h",  "lep3h",  my_meta$group)
my_meta$group <- gsub("leptinARC24h", "lep27h", my_meta$group)
my_meta$group <- gsub("leptinARC72h", "lep75h", my_meta$group)
my_meta$group <- factor(my_meta$group, levels = c("ob", "lep3h", "lep27h", "lep75h", "wt"))

my_meta <- my_meta[order(my_meta$cluster, my_meta$group), ]

my_meta_sub <- my_meta[my_meta$cluster %in% c("0", "3", "17"), ]
data3_sub   <- data3[, rownames(my_meta_sub), drop = FALSE]
for_plot    <- data3_sub[, match(rownames(my_meta_sub), colnames(data3_sub))]

colors     <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(400)
breaksList <- seq(-2, 2, by = 0.01)

```

## Heatmap: all STAT3 targets, averaged per cluster

```{r, fig3G.ARC.STAT3.targets.prep}

set.seed("42")

grps <- unique(my_meta_sub)

for_plot2 <- sapply(1:nrow(grps), function(x){
  for_out <- rowMeans(for_plot[, my_meta_sub[,1] == grps[x,1] & my_meta_sub[,2] == grps[x,2], drop = FALSE])
  return(for_out)
})

colnames(for_plot2) <- apply(grps, 1, paste0, collapse = "_")
rownames(grps) <- colnames(for_plot2)

# Keep only WT columns, filter genes with zero variance across WT clusters
for_plot3 <- for_plot2[
  !apply(for_plot2[, grepl("wt", colnames(for_plot2)), drop = FALSE], 1, var) == 0,
  grepl("wt", colnames(for_plot2))
]

```

```{R, fig3G.ARC.STAT3.targets, fig.height=9, fig.width=4}

# First pass: derive gene order via hierarchical clustering
p_clust <- pheatmap(for_plot3,
                    cutree_rows = 8,
                    scale       = "row",
                    silent      = TRUE)

row_meta_g <- data.frame(gene_cluster = factor(cutree(p_clust$tree_row, k = 8)))

# Final plot: fixed row order, gene cluster annotation
p_final <- pheatmap(
  for_plot3[p_clust$tree_row$order, ],
  main             = "STAT3 target gene expression\n(WT — cluster 0: AgRP/LepR | cluster 3: POMC/LepR | cluster 17: BNC2/LepR)",
  scale            = "row",
  annotation_row   = row_meta_g,
  cluster_cols     = FALSE,
  cluster_rows     = FALSE,
  show_rownames    = FALSE,
  show_colnames    = TRUE,
  breaks           = breaksList,
  color            = colors,
  silent           = TRUE
)

print(p_final)

# Export gene order
dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
gene_order_g3g <- rownames(for_plot3)[p_clust$tree_row$order]
write.csv(
  data.frame(
    gene         = gene_order_g3g,
    gene_cluster = cutree(p_clust$tree_row, k = 6)[p_clust$tree_row$order],
    row          = seq_along(gene_order_g3g)
  ),
  "tables/ARC_STAT3_targets_wt_clust0_3_17_gene_order.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

row_meta_all <- row_meta_g
```

# Fig 3H — Gene ontology enrichment of STAT3 target gene clusters

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
GO biological process (BP) over-representation analysis was run on each gene cluster identified in Fig 3G using `clusterProfiler::compareCluster`. Three background gene sets are compared across tabs:

- **Whole genome** — default `org.Mm.eg.db` background (no universe restriction)
- **HVGs** — Seurat highly variable genes from the RNA component of the ARC object (computed before subsetting to STAT3 targets)
- **All regulon targets** — all SCENIC+ peak-to-gene target genes across all TFs (the full `r2g` table), providing a regulon-aware background
:::

```{r, fig3H.ARC.STAT3.clusters.GSA.shared}

library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

# Gene cluster lists — shared across all three background approaches
mydf    <- row_meta_all
levs    <- levels(mydf$gene_cluster)
for_out <- sapply(levs, function(x) rownames(mydf)[mydf$gene_cluster == x])
names(for_out) <- paste0("Cluster ", levs)

```

```{r, fig3H.hvg.mf.prep}
  test_res_hvg_mf@compareClusterResult$Description, width = 50)

write.csv(as.data.frame(test_res_hvg_mf),
          "tables/ARC_STAT3_GO_MF_hvg_bg.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{R, fig3H.hvg.mf.top5, fig.height=8, fig.width=9}

  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 80, 180)) +
  ggtitle("GO:MF — top 5 terms per cluster\n(background: Seurat HVGs)")
```
